facts.headline: 1 hour 45 minutes • All Ages
facts.description: Meet The Locals, On Foot, At Eye Level If you're like us, you think of travel as more than just “going places.” You crave experience and discovery, not just monuments and museums. You want to understand what's behind the touristic façade that most people never penetrate. That's why the Southernmost Walking Tour is the best way to immerse you into the history and culture of Key West! When you're on foot, the world can't slide past you faster than you can absorb it. You'll have time - and proximity - to get up close to the region's culture and natural history. Start your tour at the famous Cuban sandal factory - Kino Sandals before heading off toward the Southernmost Point of the continental United States. Along the way, our incredibly knowledgeable and well-connected local guides will show you the most popular landmarks and introduce you to local culture. By the time you're finished, you'll have a uniquely fun perspective of our tiny island!

facts.description: Learn the history and culture of Key West! 2 Hours Join us for the best walking tour in Key West! You will be amazed by how much history and culture our small island has! Local Guide will take you on a time travel adventure. As you stroll through the scenic streets of the Old Town, you will learn how the island was discovered and became one of the richest cities in the USA! Hear the stories of the first industries on the island, such as shipwrecking, sponge harvesting and cigarmaking. Also, learn what key role Key West played in the Cuban fight for its independence and find out why Key West declared the war against the United States. The private tour is the best way to explore Key West and have fun with your own group of friends or family! Book Now and call us to schedule the time that is convenient for you! The tour takes place rain or shine - Ponchos will be provided if necessary. Walking Distance Please plan to walk approximately 1.4 to 1.8 miles during the tour. - Hat, sunglasses, and sunblock are a must. - Bring at least one bottle of water for yourself. facts.description: Ever wondered how the island of Key West was discovered and became so rich? Explore Key West's history, lore, and legends from the ground up with an intimate walking tour. Whether you want to learn more about the island's first industries such as shipwrecking and cigarmaking, are curious about local history, or are looking for a fun-filled walk, Key West's Historic Districts are waiting for you! This small-group walking tour offers both an educational experience and unparalleled delight for the lovers of history and culture. Our experienced local tour guides will lead you on an impressive stroll through the scenic streets of the Old Town where you can connect with the culture of a historic city. This unique experience is enjoyed by visitors from across the world and is a must-do while in Key West! What to bring and to wear: Comfortable clothing and shoes, sunscreen, hat, sunglasses, water.

facts.description: Come aboard the Schooner Jolly II Rover for an unforgettable sunset sailing experience - With a Hint of Piracy!- in the glistening waters of the Florida Keys. Rates Adult (13+): $85 Child (4-12): $45 Infant (3 and younger): Free 2 Hours This square-rigged, 80 foot topsail schooner, built in 1994, will transport you back in time with its tanbark colored sails and cannons. Enjoy an exciting, romantic, sailing experience while basking in the amazing views of a Florida sunset. See Key West's gorgeous Historic Seaport, known locally as the Key West Bight. Once known for its shrimp boats, it is today both a beautiful sight and rich with history and waterfront culture. During the sail, you will see: - The renowned Key West sunset (and maybe even the "green flash" when the sun changes color for a moment if you're lucky) - Ocean wildlife, including schools of dolphins - Mallory Square, home of the Key West historical sculpture garden - Fort Zachary Taylor - The Navy Mole, a submarine base - Truman Annex, President Truman's "Winter Whitehouse" - "Christmas Tree Island" - Sunset Key, known for its multi-million dollar celebrity homes Join us today for an experience of a lifetime that you will never forget!

facts.description: Six Fins is the only jet ski operator in Key West offering a full two-hour guided island circumnavigation - competitors run the same 28-mile route in 90 minutes, we run it slower, with stops, on brand-new Yamaha VX Waverunners. Your USCG-licensed lead guide narrates landmarks, points out marine life, and keeps the group together. Available from the Perry Hotel & Marina. Quick facts: • 2 hours • Perry Hotel & Marina • USCG-licensed lead guide • Brand-new Yamaha VX Waverunners • Small-group format Good to know before you book Florida boater safety card - If you were born on or after January 1, 1988, Florida law requires an approved boating safety course and a Boating Safety Education ID card to operate a jet ski. Bring it with you. No card, no problem - you can still ride as a passenger. Waivers - Everyone riding, including minors, signs the Florida Personal Watercraft Agreement and our rental waiver. We email them with your confirmation. Sign before you arrive and you'll be on the water faster. Age - Drivers must be 16 or older. Passengers as young as 6 can ride along with an adult. Arrive 30 minutes early - Check-in and your safety briefing take time. Coming early protects your full ride time. Limits - Max 530 lbs and 3 riders per jet ski: one driver plus up to 2 passengers.
facts.detailsText: IMPORTANT: Please read before your tour. This confirmation contains safety rules, arrival details, and required actions. Dear Guests, We're thrilled to host your upcoming jet ski tour with Six Fins Jet Ski Rental in the beautiful oceans of Key West, Florida. To ensure a smooth and unforgettable experience, please review the important information below. Waivers - Insurance • All Drivers and passengers must sign the liability waiver. Parents and guardians sign for minors. Please sign before arriving for your tour [here:](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/2d6tk6rpsccd3k2bqcfeui/web/) Livery Attestation • All Drivers and passengers must sign the livery waiver. Parents and guardians sign for minors. Please sign before arriving for your tour [here:](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/mbsnn3yekudiwguswyjbhr/web/) Boater Safety Course - Drivers Only • Drivers born after Jan 1, 1988, must complete a Temporary Boater Safety Course (and bring proof) [here:](https://boattests101.com/united-states/florida/florida-rental?mcid=6mu7rail). The fee is $9.99. ✅ Tip: Take the boater test BEFORE you arrive. Otherwise, you must arrive at least 1 hour early to allow time to complete and pass. Tour Summary 🕒 Duration: 2 hours | Distance: 28 miles 📍 Location: The Perry Hotel and Marina, 7025 Shrimp Road at Coconut Row, Dock J Slip 1, Key West, FL 33040 - Walk down the ramp to the dock across the road from the Bad Boy Taqueria & Tequila Restaurant 🕘 Arrival: Please arrive 30 minutes early 👥 Group Size: Max 6 skis | 3 riders per ski (1 driver + up to 2 passengers) 👶 Age Limits: 6+ to ride with an adult, 16+ to drive (alone) 🌊 A note on sargassum (seaweed): The Florida Keys are seeing a heavy seaweed season this year. On some days our guides adjust the tour route - at times around the island's Atlantic side - to steer clear of seaweed-clogged channels and keep your ride safe and smooth. You'll still get the full guided experience: your captain picks the best route each morning based on that day's conditions and reviews it with you at the dock before launch. What's Included • Guided 2-hour tour with an experienced guide • 2024 Yamaha VX Waverunners • Resort Day pass to Perry Hotel pools, gym, and restaurants • 10% discount on Six Fins luxury boat charters for one year [here:](sixfinscharter.com) • Coast Guard-approved life vests and safety equipment • Free shuttle service to Perry Hotel from downtown (schedule varies) Photography Your guide will take photographs for you and text them to you after the tour! Tour Highlights • Southernmost Point - Snap a photo at the iconic marker • Boca Chica Sandbar - Relax and swim at this hidden gem • Spot dolphins, sea turtles, and more • Wrecks • Free ride areas Note: Tour route may vary depending on weather conditions. What to Bring • Towel • Sunscreen & sunglasses • Snacks & non-alcoholic beverages • We recommend leaving electronics/valuables at the secure dock box Tips & Payments • Tips for your guide are greatly appreciated. A typical gratuity is 20% of the base price ($209 per jet ski), or $42. • Bottled water, $1.00 each. Policies Check-In & Requirements • Insurance Waivers and Boater Safety Course must be completed before arrival. Drivers must also carry photo ID while on the water, as required by Florida law. • Arrive at least 30 minutes early. If you have not taken the Boater Safety Course, arrive 1 hour early. • Safety instructions and on-water hand signals are given in English. Every driver must be able to understand them. Ticket and Boarding Information • Tours depart promptly. Late arrivals will miss the tour and will not receive a refund. • Rescheduling is available if the tour is canceled due to weather or other safety concerns. • Modifications to the tour due to weather or other conditions do not qualify for refunds. • All minors must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. Reservation Policy • Every guest, including children, must have a reservation. Cancellation Policy • Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours before departure to receive a refund. • Same-day cancellations and no-shows are non-refundable. • Tickets purchased within 48 hours of departure are non-refundable. Weather & Conditions Policy • Tours will not operate in unsafe weather. Six Fins Jet Ski Rental reserves the right to cancel or reschedule for safety. Alcohol Policy • No alcohol before the tour. Guests under the influence or with alcohol will not be permitted to ride and will not be refunded. Privacy Policy • We may contact you via email about your reservation and for marketing purposes. • You may opt out of marketing communications at any time. • Locations may be under video surveillance. • Photos or videos may be used on social media unless you object in writing. Responsibility / Damages The renter is financially responsible for any damage or loss of equipment. • Repair/replacement charges: - Impeller: $1,000 - Damaged Seats: $500/seat - Flooded Engine: $750 - Lost Key: $70 - Cracked Hull: $100/sq in - Total Loss: $10,000 • $200/day charge applies until unit is rentable again (max $10,000). Therefore, we strongly recommend that you purchase the Damage Protection Policy Coverage from your concierge or guide at the jet ski dock for only $40. Disclaimer • By riding or operating a jet ski, participants accept all responsibility for their safety and any damage caused. • Six Fins Jet Ski Rental is not responsible for lost or damaged personal items. ________________________________________ We appreciate your cooperation with these policies and look forward to providing you with an unforgettable jet ski experience! factualSentences: This majestic naval ship, purposefully sunk in 2009, serves as Key West's most expansive and captivating artificial reef.
Located approximately 6 miles south-southeast of Key West within the pristine Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary (FKNMS), the Vandenberg rests at a depth of 140 feet.
facts.description: During our exhilarating 2-tank morning wreck dive, we explore the legendary USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg, renowned as the world's second-largest artificial reef. This majestic naval ship, purposefully sunk in 2009, serves as Key West's most expansive and captivating artificial reef. Located approximately 6 miles south-southeast of Key West within the pristine Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary (FKNMS), the Vandenberg rests at a depth of 140 feet. Our adventure takes us to a maximum depth of 100 feet, allowing us to navigate the expansive deck of this colossal vessel. The dive unveils an underwater landscape teeming with marine biodiversity, with the ship's towering structures now encrusted with colorful corals and bustling with vibrant sea life. Each tank offers a unique perspective-whether gliding along the deck's remnants or peering into the ship's intriguing corridors, the Vandenberg promises an unforgettable underwater experience.
facts.detailsText: VANDENBERG WRECK DIVE - ADVANCED DIVE (READ CAREFULLY) This is an advanced, high risk dive. Not for beginners. Please read everything below carefully before arrival. CHECK-IN LOCATION Southpoint Divers - [606 Front St, Key West, FL 33040](https://goo.gl/maps/LDskY2AXDky), Our 46' custom dive boat, The Phoenix, docks at the Hyatt Marina, across the street from the shop. Arrival Time: 8:00am SHARP -Boat departs from Hyatt Centric (across the street) at 8:30am -We do not wait for late arrivals Late arrivals = missed dive, no refund Required Experience The Vandenberg is a deep, advanced wreck dive with potential for: -Strong currents -Limited visibility -Depth and overhead environments To participate, you must, -Be Advanced Open Water certified (or equivalent) -Have dived within the last 12 months -Be comfortable in deeper water and variable conditions -Open Water Certified MUST have dived within the last 6 months and REQUIRES a guide ($50) MEDICAL (FOR REFERENCE) [PADI Medical Form](https://www.padi.com/sites/default/files/documents/2022-12/Diver_Medical_Participant_Questionnaire_10346_EN_English_2022-02-01.pdf) - This is provided as reference for general dive fitness - if you have any medical concerns, you are responsible for obtaining Doctor clearance prior to arrival - Certification card (required) - Towel & swimsuit - We encourage you to use mineral-based reef safe sunscreen and use Ultraviolet Protection Factor (UPF) sunwear. - Recommended - motion sickness prevention - surface marker Buoy OPTIONAL BUT STRONGLY RECOMMENDED - Guide ($50) - Strongly recommend if unfamiliar with the Vandenberg - Dive computer (required if you do not have one) - GoPro Rental DIVE CONDITIONS - 2-tank wreck dive - Conditions vary daily - This is a serious dive profile IMPORTANT REMINDERS No flying within 24 hours after diving Ocean conditions are unpredictable- plan accordingly CREW GRATUITY If you had a great experience - Typical gratuity: 15-20% per person Always appreciated, Never required Please watch this short video Please watch this short [video](https://nmsfloridakeys.blob.core.windows.net/floridakeys-prod/media/videos/reef-etiquette.mp4) to learn more about diving and snorkeling in Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary and how you can help to protect this special place! routeNotes: Get ready to explore paradise one sweet bite at a time on the Underground Donut Tour Key West. This laid-back, flavor-packed walking tour starts at Glazed Donuts, where we kick things off with freshly made donuts before heading out to wander the streets of Old Town Key West. From there, the tour becomes a delicious adventure through the island, mixing tropical vibes, local history, and plenty of sweet stops along the way.​ As we stroll through Old Town, you'll sample a variety of beloved Key West treats based on what the group is most excited to try. That could mean classic Key lime pie, cookies, ice cream, local donuts, or even “Key West donuts,” better known as conch fritters. Every tour is a little different, making each experience unique and tailored to the group's tastes. Along the way, your guide will share fun stories, quirky local lore, and insights into what makes Key West such a one-of-a-kind destination. With beautiful scenery, plenty of photo opportunities, and a rotating lineup of incredible sweet treats, this tour is perfect for couples, friends, families, or anyone who wants to experience Key West in a fun, relaxed, and delicious way.
